absence_routing_invariants.finding: Present(value:null), present empty object and absent are distinct wire cases. Strong forbids LegacyValue. Value audit binds request/challenge/range/epoch, two distinct metadata contexts, nonzero metadata term/read index and snapshot floor.
Validates exact typed response; enforced native birth promotes deployment-default request to Strong and refuses legacy response. Malformed/uncorrelated/unsupported is error, not Option::None.

Redirect refresh/backoff and retryable unavailable remain errors/retry under same absolute deadline; only validated Value/allowed deployment-default LegacyValue becomes Option. Explicit get_strong rejects legacy through transport wire validation. No manual shard hints are required for point-key hashing.

Native typed RPC is not HTTP. This review establishes no blanket HTTP404 classification or arbitrary PostgreSQL/REST Strong semantics; those frontends need their own mapped consistency contract and evidence.
